DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS).

The clinical picture of fever, altered mental status, generalized rigidity, and profuse sweating in a patient taking haloperidol is highly characteristic of NMS. The normal deep tendon reflexes and bilateral downgoing plantar responses help distinguish this from serotonin syndrome.
